senses.gloss: c. (b. h. , v. Ges. Thes. s. v. נָאַד) leather bottle, skin. Ges. R. s. 53 (ref. to Ps. LVI, 9) כאותה בעלת נ׳ as (thou didst to) that woman carrying the water bottle (Hagar); Yalk. Ps. 774 נֹאד; Yalk. Gen. 94.
units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 6:3">Lev. R. s. 6</cite> <he>משביעין האדם … אתמול היה הנ׳ הזה וכ׳</he> they administer an oath to a person by the book of the Law and bring before him blown-up (empty) hides, to intimate, yesterday this hide was filled with sinews and bones and now it is empty, so will he who wantonly causes his neighbor to swear become empty &c. Mekh. B’shall., Shir., s. 6 (ref. to <he>ונֵד</he> <cite ref="Exodus 15:8">Ex. XV, 8</cite>) <he>מה נֹד צרור וכ׳</he> as a tied-up skin stands and neither lets (air) escape nor receives any &c.; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 248:3">Yalk. Ex. 248</cite> <cite ref="N00309"><he>נוֹד</he></cite>; a. e.—Pl. <he>נוֹדוֹת</he>. Lev. R. l. c. <he>נ׳ נפיחים</he>, v. supra. Y. Taan. IV, 69ᵇ top <he>נ׳ נפוחות</he>; <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 2:4">Lam. R. to II, 2</cite> <he>נ׳ מנופחות</he> blown-up bottles (having the appearance of being filled with water).
<cite ref="Mishnah Avodah Zarah 2:4">Ab. Zar. II, 4</cite>; a. e.
